Overhaul v1.1.1e (4 January 2021) |previous_update = [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] |next_update = [[Overhaul v1.2|April Fools 2021 Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Overhaul v1.1''' was the twenty-sixth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 31st of October 2020. This update is notable for bringing the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], the sixth event in Tower Defense Simulator. Unlike with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was an official name for this update, that being the '''Halloween Update.''' However, it is referred to as '''Halloween 2020 Update''' here to avoid it being confused with a different update that added the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. '''Overhaul v1.1''' has been retroactively applied to this update to keep in line with the numbering scheme with the other updates. This version encompassed nine updates, the main Overhaul v1.1.0 update (released 31 October 2020) and eight minor updates, the Overhaul v1.1.0a (released 1 November 2020), Overhaul v1.1.0b (released 7 November 2020), Overhaul v1.1.1 (released 23 November 2020), Overhaul v1.1.1a (released the same day as Overhaul v1.1.1, 23 November 2020), Overhaul v1.1.1b (released 26 November 2020), Overhaul
